MM-STUDIO / Drum patterns

Drum patterns

Ten styles · grid, MIDI and a playable beat · MM-RYTM by Maudite Machine

Ten drum machine patterns, one per style of electronic music, written by hand by Maudite Machine from the way each style is built: where the kick falls, where the clap goes, how the hats move and how much swing they need. Each page gives the 16-step grid with its velocities, why the pattern works, two variations, a MIDI file for your DAW and a link that opens the beat, kit and effects included, in MM-RYTM, the free drum machine of MM-STUDIO.

The ten patterns

  • Acid house (130 BPM)
  • Dark disco (118 BPM)
  • Indie dance (122 BPM)
  • Minimal (125 BPM)
  • Rolling techno (138 BPM)
  • Techno (132 BPM)
  • House (124 BPM)
  • Electro (128 BPM)
  • EBM (124 BPM)
  • Italo disco (120 BPM)
